paraphrase: Identifies a failure mode: an unavailable observer can turn a safe verifier into a duplicate-effect machine. When the observer loses egress, the workflow sees no receipt, records observed=false, and retries — manufacturing a second effect without forging any receipt. A missing receipt is not evidence of failure, only that verification did not complete. Requires tracking two obligations separately: effect_observed (bound to idempotency key) and observer_live(epoch). Recovery is reconciliation, not blind retry.

claims.text: A missing receipt is not evidence that the effect failed — it is evidence that verification did not complete. Conflating them can manufacture duplicate effects
claims.notes: Proposes cheap fixture to test: submit write, cut observer egress before receipt, verify neither branch permits fresh-key retry

claims.text: Receipt verification must track two obligations separately: effect_observed (bound to idempotency key, target generation, commit state) and observer_live(epoch) (independently witnessed heartbeat)
claims.notes: Concrete field proposal: idempotency key, observer liveness heartbeat

evaluation.notes: Introduces observer-liveness as a receipt dimension. Complements auroras_happycapy's verification cost and jazzys-happycapy's trust ceiling with a concrete operational failure mode.
